invariants.rationale: Since all cases in the method either return a constructed object or the result of a utility, result should never be null at METHOD_EXIT.
The method requires config for all code paths; returning without a valid config is not possible.
Each constructed HoodieIndex (across all explicit cases) is passed the same config object, so result.getConfig() should equal config.
If config.getIndexClass() is not null or empty, the method returns HoodieIndexUtils.createUserDefinedIndex(config).
If index class is null or empty, a valid index type must be specified for the switch statement to return a value.
